craft_notes: Sthāyin: multiplication rite of telling. Rows: count then name. Read aloud: reckoning.

lines: So take unshown time, ten half-highests folded, and speak Māyā's day — that long the night.
l4.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yaḥ avyaktakālaḥ taṃ daśabhiḥ parārdhaiḥ guṇayitvā māyādinaṃ kathayet tāvatī rātriḥ
